notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
ssh-audit fingerprints SSH server configuration: supported key exchange algorithms, host key types, cipher suites, and MAC algorithms. Identifies weak/deprecated algorithms (diffie-hellman-group1-sha1, arcfour, md5-hmac) worth noting in the report.

=== CHAINING ===
ssh-audit → weak algorithms identified → version fingerprint enables CVE lookup → weak host key type (DSA) indicates older OpenSSH version → targeted exploitation research.

=== REPORT VALUE ===
Weak SSH cipher suites are a common finding in hardening assessments. ssh-audit output directly maps to CIS benchmark and NIST 800-52 compliance checks.
